thread:
ashley: Heads-up — quarterly utilization scan flagged ~12% of our p4d reserved hours idle across eu-west-3 and us-west-2. Need quick decision on renew vs reallocate. (thread_ts=2174503210)

tariq: baseline question — is that 12% steady or peaky? monthly avg vs weekdays?

ashley: monthly average over last 90d. Weekday usage high, weekends much lower. Attached infra script output: 
```
$ infra-costs show --type reserved --family p4d --window 90d --group region
eu-west-3: 1300 reserved hours used / 1500 purchased (86.7%)
us-west-2: 2200 / 3000 (73.3%)
ap-northeast-1: 2900 / 2900 (100%)
```
Note: some US reservations expire 2026-09-30.

priya: term left on those reservations? convertible?

ops-bot: [savingsplan-bot] Detected convertible RIs: 4 (p4d family) -> convertible to compute savings plan. Estimated immediate cost delta if converted now: ~-12% for covered hours.

lucas-finance: We can't expand committed spend. If we don't renew, on-demand cost for that delta is ~+35% vs current reserved. Need break-even calc for convert vs renew vs drop.

jordan: quick back-of-envelope: converting to regional SP (1yr) keeps flexibility and should cut the mismatch losses, but depends on which workloads are region-pinned. Could also consider partial exchange.

tariq: before any conversion/migration: what workloads are pinned to us-west-2? data locality or license constraints?

ashley: A handful of customers pinned to us-west-2 for data egress/compliance. Most training workers are stateless and could be shifted. I'll list owners.

priya: propose a 14-day canary: move 10% of stateless training workers from us-west-2 -> ap-northeast-1, monitor RU/hour and tail-latency. Autoscale cap at current steady-state + 10% burst. If we free >=8% of hours we avoid full RI renew.

ashley: good plan. Action items: 
- priya: run 14d canary migrating ~10% of workload (start Mon)
- tariq: inventory pinned node pools + owners (deliverable Tue)
- lucas-finance: model cost for 1yr renewing RI vs converting to 1yr SP vs letting lapse (deliverable EOD Wed)
- ops-bot: start daily utilization report at 08:00 UTC

ops-bot: scheduled report created: /reports/2174503210-utilization.csv — will post daily.

tariq: I'll DM owners and flag potential migration windows.

ashley: If the canary shows >=8% freed capacity we should NOT renew the full RI; otherwise renew 1yr regional SP for us-west-2 and convert any convertible RIs.

lucas-finance: noted — I'll run break-even including early-conversion fees and estimated migration cost. Target EOD Wed.

priya: tiny technical Q — convertible RI -> SP requires instance family compatibility. Can we convert p4d -> other GPU families? ops-bot?

ops-bot: Convertible RIs can be exchanged across instance sizes/regions within the same tenancy and platform if the underlying attributes match. Recommend review of architecture compatibility before exchange. Example terraform snippet for SP creation: 
```
resource "aws_savings_plan" "compute" {
  compute_type = "EC2"
  region = "us-west-2"
  term = "one-year"
}
```

jordan: also watch networking egress cost when moving traffic regionally — migrations may increase egress and nullify some savings. Add that to Lucas' calc.

ashley: Good catch. Lucas — include estimated one-time migration egress + incremental monthly egress delta.

lucas-finance: Will include. One more ask: if we convert now, is there any downside for customer-pinned nodes? i.e., do conversions relate to tenancy?

priya: conversions are at the account/region level — pinned nodes tied to project-level placements won't be magically covered if they stay in a different region. We'll need to align placement or keep a smaller RI pool.

ashley: Let's sync Tue 11:00 to review canary plan and the inventory. I'll post calendar invite. :thumbsup:

jordan: +1

lucas-finance: +1

ashley: I'll post daily updates in this thread — canary metrics, utilization CSV link, and next steps. :spiral_calendar:
